ul.li: Strain gage location is critical parameter for strain accuracy.
Intel recommends use of silkscreen print on PCB opposite of package as shown (Figure 1).
Strain gage symbol is available. Ask your Intel field representative for more information.
Strain gage rosette center will be published with x, y coordinates with (0,0) in package center (Figure 3).
PCB coordinate system may have different center (0,0) location; strain gage coordinates may need to be offset or adjusted for local package coordinate center.

body.p: Refer to Shock Strain Monitoring Approach Customer Reference Document (#426413)
